findings.issue: H3709 כַּף is an open common noun (palm, hollow, pan, or spoon). Cuchara locks it to a spoon, a specialized utensil the morphology does not select.
כַּף is construct, so ten gold is its genitive. The comma leaves diez oro readable as a separate item.
מְלֵאָה is an adjective whose complement is incense. llena is also a finite verb, and without a link the phrase can read as fills incense.

notes: עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב licenses diez oro; no shekel token is present to add.
